mathematical_checks.CF4: Early a*A1+b*A2 acts first; late b*A1+a*A2 follows. With a+b=1/2 and static W>=0, each generator has dissipative Hermitian part -W/2. Negative b alone does not imply CAP antidamping.
mathematical_checks.Coulomb_phase: Analytic projectile integral has correct sign and static-velocity limit; quadrature tests cover positive, negative, tiny and zero velocity. No soft core introduced.
mathematical_checks.CAP: A=-iH-W and augmented loss derivative 2<psi,W psi> have correct sign. Ledger closure is a consistency check, not a CAP-reflection/bias bound.
mathematical_checks.vector_decomposition: Raw endpoint telescope S-E_mid + E_mid-E_avg + E_avg-U closes; Gram cross terms reconstruct squared error. Independent phase alignment is correctly excluded.
mathematical_checks.temporal_models: Unequal actual-step signed single-power fit, even dt2+dt4 interpolation and null degree-six ambiguity are correct. No fit closes a budget or replaces raw capture by P/norm.
mathematical_checks.independence: Full-H dense expm/DOP853 differs from frozen FFT split products but shares H_h; this is temporal independence, not continuum spatial independence.

resource_and_performance_checks.fullH_cli: Even three-dimensional shape, <=512 grid points, <=64 steps per ladder method, <=2 atomic-time horizon and <=20000 RHS calls per oracle; no production grid admitted.

resource_and_performance_checks.memory_limits: Working-byte estimates and sampled counters are explicitly not peak proofs. RSS is a process lifetime peak of setup and both implementations, not isolated A/B memory reduction.
resource_and_performance_checks.timing: Two warmups per implementation, alternating measured order, fixed state/grid/dtype/CAP/actual dt/horizon, parity gate before speed ratio and no full-grid extrapolation.
resource_and_performance_checks.measured_CPU_scope: Intel Xeon web runtime, 64x64x96 complex128, four steps, five repeats; not user workstation or production throughput.
